effects: `assets` USDT leave the signer and go to the vault (ERC4626 _deposit, safeTransferFrom caller to vault), then the vault supplies them to Morpho markets.
Vault shares (steakUSDTlite) are minted to `receiver`; the number is computed from vault totals in storage (floor rounding), with no minimum in the calldata.
formats.shown: Deposit: the USDT amount, the share ticker steakUSDTlite and the address that gets the shares.

findings.title: deposit: number of shares received is not shown; the vault computes it from storage.
findings.evidence: MetaMorphoV1_1.sol deposit(): shares = _convertToSharesWithTotals(assets, totalSupply(), lastTotalAssets, Floor). Case 0: signer received 9660849369919166 steakUSDTlite (0.00966); the screen shows only the ticker 'Share ticker: steakUSDTlite'. Reader unsure 'How many shares I'll get'.
findings.fix: No calldata value holds it. A label such as 'Shares (amount set by vault price)' would help.

findings.title: deposit: intent 'Deposit' does not name the asset, amount or vault; there is no interpolatedIntent.
findings.evidence: descriptor deposit format: "intent": "Deposit" and no interpolatedIntent; the fields carry the 0.01 USDT and the receiver.

cases.notes: USDT out 0.01 shown exactly. Shares in: the asset and the receiver (the signer) are shown, but the amount is not. The vault sets it, so a descriptor cannot show it.

effects: USDT leaves the signer for the vault. The amount is computed from vault totals (ceil rounding) and nothing in the calldata caps it.
Exactly `shares` steakUSDTlite vault shares are minted to `receiver`.
formats.shown: Mint: deposit asset 'USDT' with no amount, the exact shares minted in steakUSDTlite, and the receiver of the shares.

findings.title: mint: USDT amount paid is not shown; the vault computes it and the calldata has no maximum.
findings.evidence: MetaMorphoV1_1.sol mint(): assets = _convertToAssetsWithTotals(shares, totalSupply(), lastTotalAssets, Ceil); _deposit pulls `assets` from caller. Case 1: signer paid 2 (0.000002) USDT; screen shows 'Deposit asset: USDT' only. Reader unsure 'How much USDT is deposited'.
findings.fix: No calldata value holds it. Label the field 'Pay with (amount set by vault price)' so the signer knows the amount is not shown.

findings.title: mint: intent 'Mint' does not say USDT leaves the wallet; the payment is only in a ticker field.
findings.evidence: descriptor mint format: "intent": "Mint", field 'Deposit asset' = raw constant underlyingTicker 'USDT'. In the deposit format, the same label 'Deposit asset' holds an amount.
findings.fix: Use intent 'Deposit USDT for shares' and interpolatedIntent 'Mint {shares} to {receiver}, paying USDT'. Rename the field 'Pays with'.

cases.notes: USDT out: the asset and direction are shown, the amount (2 base units) is not. The shares went to 0xdEaD, not the signer, and the screen shows that correctly.

formats.key: withdraw(uint256 assets, address receiver, address owner)
effects: Exactly `assets` USDT go from the vault to `receiver`.
steakUSDTlite shares of `owner` are burned. The number is computed from vault totals (ceil rounding) with no maximum in the calldata.
If the caller is not `owner`, the caller's share allowance from `owner` is spent by that share amount.
formats.shown: Withdraw: the exact USDT amount, the receiver and the owner whose shares are used.

findings.title: withdraw: the shares burned from owner are not stated, by amount or by token.
findings.evidence: MetaMorphoV1_1.sol withdraw(): shares = _convertToSharesWithTotals(assets, totalSupply(), lastTotalAssets, Ceil); _withdraw burns them from owner. The descriptor fields are only assets, receiver and owner.
findings.fix: The amount comes from storage. Add a constant field 'Shares burned: steakUSDTlite' to name the token.

formats.key: redeem(uint256 shares, address receiver, address owner)
effects: Exactly `shares` steakUSDTlite shares of `owner` are burned. If the caller is not owner, the caller's allowance from owner is spent.
USDT goes from the vault to `receiver`. The amount is computed from vault totals (floor rounding) and the calldata has no minimum.
formats.shown: Redeem: the exact shares in steakUSDTlite, the receiver and the owner. The screen never says that USDT is what arrives.

findings.title: redeem: the asset received (USDT) is not named anywhere on the screen.
findings.evidence: descriptor redeem format fields: shares, receiver, owner only. MetaMorphoV1_1.sol redeem() sends `assets` of the underlying (USDT) to receiver via _withdraw. The mint format shows the underlyingTicker constant; redeem does not.
findings.fix: Add a field {"label":"Receive asset","format":"raw","value":"$.metadata.constants.underlyingTicker"} and label the receiver 'Send USDT to'.

findings.title: redeem: USDT amount received is not shown; the vault computes it and the calldata has no minimum.
findings.evidence: MetaMorphoV1_1.sol redeem(): assets = _convertToAssetsWithTotals(shares, totalSupply(), lastTotalAssets, Floor).
findings.fix: No calldata value holds it. A label can say the amount is set by the vault price.
